answer_1.quote: We train a 6-layer Transformer model for the German-English (De-En) translation task... We use the provided checkpoint for the M2M model (418M)... We perform the quantitative analysis in 1000 sentences of the test set of IWSLT'14 German-English dataset... For the analysis in §5.5 we use FLORES-101 devtest split.

answer_2.quote: They measure BLEU score of the generated translation with and without perturbation... We measure Alignment Error Rate (AER) against human‑annotated alignments.
